The '''Tusken warrior'''<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Audio Description" /> [[Tusken Raider]] warrior who was a member of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of Tusken Raiders on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> around [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The flashback events of "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]" take place shortly after the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]].</ref> 

==History==
When the [[prisoner]] [[Boba Fett]] attempted to escape the tribe's [[Tusken Raider camp (Boba Fett)|camp]], the Tusken [[Soldier|warrior]] defeated him in a duel, allowing the rest of her tribe to recapture their captive. After Fett killed a [[sand beast]], he was accepted to the tribe.<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> The warrior instructed Fett how to fight with a [[gaderffii stick]].<ref name="Chapter 2" />

[[File:TuskenWarrior-CGSWG.png|thumb|300px|left|The Tusken warrior was extremely skilled with her gaderffii stick.]]
The tribe was later attacked by blaster bolts from a [[Tatooine repulsor train]], killing several Tusken Raiders and [[bantha]]s. After burning the fallen Tukens, Fett approached the warrior and the [[Tusken Chieftain|chieftain]], vowing to stop the train with a [[cycler rifle]] and his training gaderffii stick, promising to be back by morning. Fett walked to [[Tosche Station]], attacked members of the [[Kintan Striders Gang]], and returned to the camp with their [[speeder bike]]s. Fett explained it was a gift to the tribe, and instructed the warrior and other tribe members how to ride it.<ref name="Chapter 2" />

Later, when the warrior was training Fett in gaderffii stick, the tribe was attacked again. The warrior, Fett and other Tuskens used their speeder bikes to [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|raid]] the train. The warrior killed several [[Pyke]]s, and the tribe defeated the [[Pyke Syndicate]] soldiers that operated the train. Fett demanded that the Pykes will stop killing Tuskens and pay a toll for traveling on their land. Later that night, the warrior was present when the chieftain explained the history of the tribe to Fett. Fett was gifted with a [[Horned gekko|gekko]] that crawled inside his body, and returned in the morning with a branch of a [[Wortwood tree|wortwood]] [[tree]], which he presented to the chieftain and the warrior. The warrior took the branch, and led Fett to a [[gaderffii stick workshop]], where a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider craftsman|craftsman]] helped Fett to forge his own [[Boba Fett's gaderffii stick|stick]]. Fett presented his new stick to the warrior, which nodded in approval. Later that night, the warrior, Fett and the tribe performed a ceremonial dance around a campfire.<ref name="Chapter 2" />

After the newly-initiated Boba Fett left to see the Pyke Syndicate in [[Mos Eisley]], the Pykes [[Massacre of a Tusken Raider tribe|massacred]] the tribe, including the warrior. They painted the symbol of a speeder bike gang known as the Kintan Striders to put the blame on them.<ref name="Chapter 7">{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}</ref> Per Tusken tradition,<ref name="Chapter 2" /> Fett gathered all the bodies and weapons and burned them at a funeral pyre.<ref name="Chapter 3">{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}</ref> Fett later [[Attack on the Kintan Striders|attacked]] the Kintan Striders, killing several of their members, in revenge.<ref name="Chapter 4">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken warrior made her first appearance in a flashback sequence of the ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''{{'s}} premiere episode "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]],"<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> which began streaming to [[Disney+]] on [[December 29]], [[2021]].<ref name="Disney+ Premiere">{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}}</ref> She was portrayed by [[Joanna Bennett]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' mistakenly lists the Tusken warrior as a [[human]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
